title: A desert in the rain shadow
text: The Mojave Desert is found primarily in southeastern California and southwestern Nevada. It lies in the rain shadow of the southern Sierra Nevada and the Transverse Ranges. Storms drop their rain and snow mostly on the mountains, which leaves the slopes on the far side drier. In the Mojave part of Joshua Tree National Park, about 3 to 5 inches of rain fall in a year, mostly in winter.
